scope: Three ordinary public-court venues near El Segundo; special=false. All map points are explicitly city references, not court locations.

records.name: Recreation Park courts
records.access_evidence: The municipal facility directory describes Recreation Park as a large public park and lists basketball, tennis, pickleball, roller hockey and other sports. The city offers court reservations through ESREC.
records.fee_status: Paid reservations for tennis/pickleball and other racquet courts; a general casual-basketball fee was not established.
records.hours_or_booking_note: The official reservation policy collects card payment when racquet-court requests are made. Check ESREC for the particular court, eligibility, time and price; no park-wide court hours are asserted.
records.availability_warning: The city announced phased repairs affecting several court areas through June 2026, weather permitting. Completion and present availability were not independently verified.

evidence.retrieval: Official municipal search-index extract; direct page fetch returned 403.

records.qualification: No court total is asserted: the adult-sports page says four pickleball courts, while the February 2026 facility report lists courts 1–8. The separate high-school resident-only basketball programme is not used as evidence for these outdoor park courts.
records.location_basis: municipality representative coordinate; not a court or entrance

records.name: Manhattan Heights Park courts
records.address: 1600 Manhattan Beach Boulevard, Manhattan Beach, CA 90266
records.access_evidence: The city park directory lists outdoor basketball suitable for pickup play and reservable tennis/pickleball facilities. The municipal reservations page explicitly permits residents and nonresidents to reserve courts.
records.fee_status: Paid tennis/pickleball reservations. Municipal page lists USD 10/hour for residents and USD 14/hour for nonresidents; verify the actual chosen court in the booking system. Basketball fee not established.
records.hours_or_booking_note: Published Manhattan Heights court reservation hours: 08:00–20:00, final reservation 19:00. Online reservations up to four days ahead for residents and three days for nonresidents; up to two one-hour reservations per day. These hours are not asserted for every basketball court.

evidence.supports: Park location, sports amenities and pickup basketball
